# UiPagination

Moves between pages of a result set.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | navigation |
| Import | `import { UiPagination } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiPagination from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiPagination'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/navigation/UiPagination.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/navigation/UiPagination.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pageCount` | `number` |  | Number of pages. Alternatively pass `total` and `pageSize`. |
| `total` | `number` |  | Number of items across all pages. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `10` | Items per page, used with `total`. |
| `siblings` | `number` | `1` | Page buttons shown on each side of the current page. |
| `boundaries` | `number` | `1` | Page buttons always shown at the start and at the end. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the navigation landmark. |
| `size` | `UiSize` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:page` | `number` | required | Current page, starting at 1. |

## Attributes

The `<nav>` element.

## Keyboard

- Every page control is a button in the tab order (Enter/Space).

## Accessibility

- A labelled `<nav>`; the current page has `aria-current="page"` and a translated name.
- Previous/next have translated names and mirror in right-to-left text.
- Narrow containers collapse the page buttons to "Page x of y".

## Styling

- `.vui-pagination`, `.vui-pagination__button`, `.vui-pagination__status`
- `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/NavigationDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/NavigationDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-3">
  <UiPagination v-model:page="page" :total="240" :page-size="10" />
  <!-- A narrow container collapses to "Page x of y". -->
  <div class="w-56 rounded-vui border border-dashed border-vui-border p-2">
    <!-- Two navigation landmarks on one page need distinct names. -->
    <UiPagination
      v-model:page="smallPage"
      :page-count="12"
      size="sm"
      :label="t('demo.pagination.compact')"
    />
  </div>
  <p class="text-vui-sm text-vui-muted" data-testid="page-value">{{ t('demo.page', { value: page }) }}</p>
</div>
```
